title: fix(app-shell): show a form view's served warnings on its Studio canvas
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb3Xddii4BxBNwmt9bKNQnRd)_

Fixes #29311

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6578174431, surface amendment 6578279049.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:在 Studio「界面」里打开一个表单视图时,如果某个分区写了对象上不存在的字段,画布顶部现在会出现黄色提示块「1 warning(s) — review recommended.」,逐条写出分区名(如 Overview)和服务端给出的原话(字段 "no_such_field" 不是对象上的字段,运行时会被静默跳过)。没有警告时什么都不显示,也不拦保存。
- **为什么改**:服务端从 #29196 起已经在读取应答里给出这条警告,但 Studio 读取视图时把 `_diagnostics` 和其他读取装饰一起剥掉了,画布拿不到,作者仍以为表单完好、字段会出现。
- **风险与回滚**:只改显示:界面支柱加载时多保存一份服务端结论,画布只读不写;编辑缓冲区仍是剥掉装饰后的正文,所以保存请求里永远不带 `_diagnostics`(测试和实测都确认)。作者改掉被警告的那个值后,这条警告会随即消失(该支柱自动保存后不重新读取)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`StudioDesignSurface.tsx` 里 InterfacesPillar 的叶子加载(`setLeafVerdict`)和 `leafDiagnostics`;`ViewPreview.tsx` 的 `FormViewWarnings`;`draftVerdict.ts` 的 `verdictEntriesStillShown`。
- **两分钟验证**:在可写包里用 API 存一个表单视图草稿,分区字段写 `no_such_field`,然后打开 `/studio/包ID/interfaces?surface=view:视图名`:画布上方出现黄色提示,写着 Overview 和字段名;改一下标签,保存请求里没有 `_diagnostics`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The Interfaces pillar keeps the served verdict of the open leaf.** Its load took the body through `extractDraftBody`, which strips `_diagnostics` with the other read decorations, and handed the canvas no verdict. The load now keeps the verdict the same way the Data pillar's object load does (`editedItemDiagnostics`: the pending draft's `_diagnostics` read before the strip, else the layered read's), beside the body it judged, in leaf-keyed state. It never enters the edit buffer, so no save carries `_diagnostics`.
- **The canvas gets it through the existing preview contract.** A memo turns it into `MetadataPreviewProps.diagnostics` (`verdictEntriesStillShown`, a new pure helper beside `serverHoldAt` in `draftVerdict.ts`). This pillar does not read the leaf again after an autosave, so an entry is dropped once the value at its path in the buffer differs from the value the verdict judged (a renamed or removed field reference); an entry with no path is kept.
- **`ViewPreview`'s form route shows the warnings** in the canvas's existing `PreviewMessage` warn block under the existing `engine.edit.diagnostics.warnTitle` heading. Each entry is named by the section it points into (`config.sections.N…`: the section's label in the designer locale, else its name; any other path as written), followed by the server's message as served. Errors are left to the editor that holds the verdict. No new i18n key, no new control.
- Page, dashboard and report previews in the same pillar now receive `diagnostics` too; none of them reads the prop today, so they render as before.

## Tests

- `ViewPreview.formWarnings-29311.test.tsx` (new, real `ViewPreview`): a warning into a section names the section by its label with the server message; a label-less section is named by its name and a path into no section is shown as written; an empty or absent list draws no block; an error-only list draws none.
- `InterfacesPillar.formViewWarnings-29311.test.tsx` (new, the off-nav deep-link harness): a pending draft's warning reaches the canvas at its path; with no draft, the layered read's verdict is handed; empty `warnings` or no `_diagnostics` hands nothing; editing the judged field drops the warning and the autosave's body carries no `_diagnostics` (and carries the edit).

## Acceptance notes

- **File surface differs from the dispatch's first list, by the seat's amendment 6578279049.** `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx`, `ObjectFormCanvas.tsx` and `FieldStub.tsx` design an object's fields and field groups, not a form view; a form view (`view`, `viewKind: 'form'`) opens in the Interfaces pillar, whose canvas is the registered `view` preview, `ViewPreview`. None of the three is touched.
- **A published form view with no pending draft shows no warning yet.** `getMetaItemLayered` computes its `_diagnostics` from the schema alone (`computeMetadataDiagnostics`), without the form-layout pass the single-item read runs since #29196. Measured on the showcase: the active read of a published form view serves the warning, its `?layers=true` read serves `{ valid: true }`. Studio and the metadata item editor read that layered answer when no draft is pending. Reported to the seat for the server lane; once the layered read carries the warning, this canvas shows it with no UI change (the no-draft branch is pinned above).
- In the metadata item editor (`ResourceEditPage`), which already lists warnings in its banner and passes the same `diagnostics` to this preview, the warning now also shows on the form canvas, as `FlowPreview` does for its problems.
- The form view inspector shows the stored body type as `simple (not found)` in its View type picker (visible in the screenshots, before and after). Not touched here.

## Verification

<details><summary>Live, on the showcase (Vite source console, scratch package over REST)</summary>

A form view draft `showcase_project.r29311_intake` whose Overview section lists `name`, `no_such_field`, `status`, saved with `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/NAME?mode=draft&package=com.qa.r29311`. Its draft read serves `_diagnostics: { valid: true, warnings: [{ path: 'config.sections.0.fields.1', message: … }] }`. Opened at `/studio/com.qa.r29311/interfaces?surface=view:showcase_project.r29311_intake`, 1440x1000:

| | main (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `ViewPreview.tsx` at the base) | this branch |
|---|---|---|
| warn block on the canvas | none | `1 warning(s) — review recommended.` / `Overview: showcase_project.r29311_intake: field "no_such_field" is not a field on object "showcase_project" — it is silently skipped and never renders on the form` |
| Label edit, autosave | | one `PUT …?mode=draft` with no `_diagnostics` and no `_draft` in its body; the warning stays (its field is unchanged) |
| published copy (`r29311_active`), no draft | none | none (layered read gap above) |

</details>

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

Each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` on effaaa79 (sources resolve to `src`, no dist leg); each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty.

- The draft verdict dropped (`draftDiagnostics: undefined` in the leaf load): pillar file 2 failed, 2 passed (the draft case and the edit case).
- The canvas block removed (`FormViewWarnings` render replaced by null): ViewPreview file 2 failed, 2 passed.
- The staleness filter removed (`verdictPreviewEntries` for `verdictEntriesStillShown`): pillar file 1 failed (the edit case), 3 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- New files: 2 files, 8 tests passed (effaaa79).
- Neighbour sweep, every test file naming `ViewPreview`, `InterfacesPillar` or `draftVerdict` (77 files, two locked batches): 40 files / 253 tests and 37 files / 610 tests passed (effaaa79).
- `turbo run type-check --filter=@object-ui/app-shell`: 65/65 tasks (effaaa79, and again on the merged head 455cacb5).
- After merging `origin/main` (455cacb5, which brings the other Studio pillar load change, #29380): the new files, every `InterfacesPillar.*` and `ViewPreview.*` file, 20 files / 104 tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 34 commands; all 34 ran with exit 0 (`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: 169 files passed, 2 skipped); `--ran` reconciliation 34/34, 0 NOT-MEASURED (effaaa79).
- eslint on the touched files: 0 errors; the touched-file warnings are pre-existing (`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`).

</details>
